<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Rajasthan election results:</strong> The Congress party has secured significant gains in Rajasthan’s local body and panchayat elections, with leaders labeling the outcome a public rejection of the BJP&#x27;s governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political expansion:</strong> The Lal Hit Janata Party (LHJP) has announced a pan-India expansion strategy, prompting national scrutiny regarding its political accountability and security implications.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>J&amp;K political discourse:</strong> The J&amp;K Deputy Chief Minister stated that the BJP&#x27;s invitation to a Pakistani minister validates the stance previously held by Omar Abdullah.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Lobbying and transparency:</strong> Experts are calling for a formal law on lobbying in India to ensure greater transparency and accountability in high-level policy decision-making.</li>
  <li><strong>Energy and industrial policy:</strong> India is exploring strategies to expand the market for biogas plants beyond current mandates to reduce reliance on LNG imports, while industry leaders urge the government to prioritize structural policy reforms.</li>
</ul>
